rows.name: Soil observation lesson
steps: Look at soil in a tray with a magnifying lens.
Find what the soil is made of: rocks, living things and things that have died.
Compare two types of soil with water.
Draw what you observe and wash hands.
rows.materials: Soil in a tray, magnifying lens, paper, pencils

levels.1: Observes with help and draws one thing seen.
levels.2: Describes the parts of soil seen with a lens and draws them.
levels.3: Compares two types of soil and gives a reason for the difference.
